svg.title: Chi-square densities across degrees of freedom
svg.desc: Four chi-square densities on one axis and, below, the seven degree-of-freedom density with its equal-tailed 95 percent cuts marked at 1.69 and 16.01.
svg.text: Chi-square: right-skewed, and the skew fades as the degrees of freedom grow
Mean k, variance 2k, and the peak at k minus 2 once k is at least 2. The mean always sits to the right of the peak.
k = 7: the middle 95 percent lies between the two cuts
The two cuts are not symmetric about the peak, which is why an interval for sigma squared built from them is lopsided.
